text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm tidying up after training one day,
I happen
to spot a suspicious figure
lurking about...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'd say that she needs a single
poke there.
As for her... maybe ten
pokes would do...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oops, you caught me! ☆ But no worries!
I haven't
laid a needle on anyone yet.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I just came here to conduct visualization
training
for my treatments. I have only
the best wishes for
Umamusume-kind's
bright future! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, stop! Let's not get hasty! Put down
the
phone for a moment!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Are you telling me that you don't care if
the
(self-proclaimed) crown jewel of the
acupuncture
world, Sasami Anshinzawa,
is gone forever?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
But you must trust me when I say this—I
have
always wished for Umamusume to
succeed and
flourish! From the bottom
of my heart!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: See? We're two peas in a pod.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, just look at the reviews on our

homepage! "Thanks to acupuncture, I
finally got
first place!" "Ever since I got
treated, every day
has been sunshine
and rainbows!"

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
See? Nothing but five-star reviews! ☆
They're all
for my master, but still!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, you're really letting me go scot-free?! So you can be reasoned with after all! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know! Let me give you a free
treatment
session as thanks! It'll be a
great chance for you
to become mighty
and strong!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
If it goes well, that is... But I'm sure it
will! See, no
worries! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I refuse her offer, but I was able to learn
a bit
more about acupuncture through
this experience.
